desc:
⚡Welcome to +1 Stickmen Escape! Start as a glowing stickman, build your speed and race through massive parkour worlds! 🏃💨

👟 Run to gain XP and level up your SPEED!
🔥 Slide, double jump, climb and WALL RUN past deadly obstacles!
🏆 Reach win pads, collect Wins and unlock stronger Stickmen!
⚡ Train on multiplier treadmills to progress even faster!
🐾 Hatch eggs, collect rare pets and boost your stats!
♻️ Rebirth for bigger multipliers!
🧪 Use potions for Speed, XP, Wins, Jump and Luck boosts!
😈 Conquer World 1 and unlock THE ABYS!
💤 Earn XP while offline — keep your daily streak for boosted rewards!

🎁 Join our community and claim your FREE 500 Wins!
👍 Enjoying the game? Leave a LIKE and ⭐ FAVORITE!
👥 Invite your friends and race to the next stage!

🎮 Play on PC, Mobile & Console!

How far can YOUR stickman go? 👀
